standard: TRIMURTI v3 — Evidence-Gated, Human-Governed, UI-First, Self-Auditing and Resumable

authorities.name_en: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
authorities.name_mr: सामाजिक न्याय व विशेष सहाय्य विभाग
authorities.inclusion_reason: Core department administering social pensions, Scheduled Caste scholarships, disability welfare, senior citizen benefits, and hostels.
Administers Scheduled Tribe welfare, post-matric ST scholarships, ashram shala stipends, Shabari Awas, and forest rights.
Administers VJNT, OBC, and Special Backward Class scholarships, tuition waivers, and educational concessions.
Administers Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana, Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, Manodhairya, and orphan welfare.
Administers Namo Shetkari Maha Samman Nidhi, Bhausaheb Fundkar Phalbag, farm mechanization, drip irrigation, and crop insurance.
Administers pre-matric scholarships, attendance allowances for girls, Ahilyabai Holkar bus travel concessions, and mid-day meals.
Administers Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj EBC Tuition Fee Waiver, Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance.

authorities.name_en: Public Health and Family Welfare Department
authorities.name_mr: सार्वजनिक आरोग्य व कुटुंब कल्याण विभाग
authorities.inclusion_reason: Administers Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY), free universal cashless treatment in empanelled hospitals.

authorities.name_en: Rural Development and Panchayati Raj Department
authorities.inclusion_reason: Administers rural sanitation, PMAY-Gramin state coordination, and MSRLM Umed self-help groups.
Oversight of 29 municipal corporations, PM SVANidhi coordination, and urban poverty alleviation schemes.
Administers Ramai Awas Yojana, Shabari Awas, MHADA lottery housing, and PMAY affordable housing.
Administers State Minority Post-Matric and Professional Scholarships, free coaching, and Maulana Azad loan schemes.

authorities.name_en: Persons with Disabilities Welfare Department (Divyang Kalyan)
authorities.inclusion_reason: Independent state department established in 2023 for disability pensions, assistive aids, motorized tricycles, and self-employment.
Administers BOCW construction workers welfare schemes, financial aid for child education, marriage assistance, and tools allowance.

authorities.name_en: Industries, Energy and Labour Department (Industries Section)
authorities.inclusion_reason: Administers Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP), interest subsidy, and capital incentives.

authorities.name_en: Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department
authorities.name_mr: कौशल्य विकास, रोजगार व उद्योजकता विभाग
authorities.inclusion_reason: Administers Pramod Mahajan Kaushalya Vikas Yojana, apprenticeship allowances, and youth employment training.

authorities.name_en: Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection Department
authorities.name_mr: अन्न, नागरी पुरवठा व ग्राहक संरक्षण विभाग
authorities.inclusion_reason: Administers Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), Priority Household (PHH) subsidized foodgrains, and Shiv Bhojan Thali.
Administers farm loan waiver verification (Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Shetkari Sanman Yojana), weaver subsidies, and PACS credit.

authorities.name_en: Animal Husbandry, Dairy Development and Fisheries Department
authorities.inclusion_reason: Administers livestock distribution, milch cow/buffalo subsidy, goat rearing schemes, and Matsya Sampada state share.

authorities.name_mr: वैद्यकीय शिक्षण व औषधी द्रव्ये विभाग
authorities.inclusion_reason: Administers tuition and exam fee reimbursement for medical, dental, and nursing students from reserved and EBC categories.
Administers Mukhyamantri Saur Krushi Pump Yojana, agricultural electricity subsidies, and domestic solar rooftop assistance.
Administers financial assistance to elderly artists in indigent circumstances (वृद्ध कलाकार मानधन योजना).
Administers natural calamity compensation (SDRF/NDRF crop damage relief), Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Bima Yojana, and land title deeds.
Administers Jal Jeevan Mission individual household tap connection subsidy in rural areas.
Administers Majhi Vasundhara incentives and rural renewable energy subsidies.
Administers Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan farm pond and soil conservation individual works.

authorities.name_en: Disaster Management, Relief and Rehabilitation Department
authorities.name_mr: आपत्ती व्यवस्थापन, मदत आणि पुनर्वसन विभाग
authorities.inclusion_reason: Administers ex-gratia relief for disaster loss of life, house damage compensation, and drought relief.
Administers District Planning and Development Committee (DPDC) welfare allocations, MLA/MP local area development, and Human Development Index programs.
Direct oversight of state treasury DBT disbursement channels, budget sanction GRs, and ex-gratia approvals.
Administers Right to Services (RTS), Aaple Sarkar citizen services portal, freedom fighter pensions, and ex-servicemen welfare.
Administers police welfare assistance, civilian gallantry rewards, and victim compensation scheme.
Administers Maharashtra State Legal Services Authority (MSLSA) free legal aid to women, SC/ST, children, and low-income citizens.
Administers MSRTC passenger fare concessions: 50% concession for women (Mahila Samman Yojana), 100% free travel for senior citizens 75+ (Amrit Jyeshtha Nagrik), and divyang travel passes.
Unemployed engineers registration and small contractor quota subsidies.
Project affected persons (PAP) rehabilitation, alternative land allotment, and compensation.
Literary awards, book publication grants, and senior Marathi scholar pensions.
Administers Maharashtra Employment Guarantee Scheme (EGS) and MGNREGA guaranteed 100 days wage employment and individual orchard planting.
Traditional toddy tapper and neera producer welfare assistance.
Oversight of municipal councils and nagar panchayats across Maharashtra for local poverty welfare programmes.
Operates the unified MahaDBT portal connecting 38+ scholarship and DBT benefit schemes.

authorities.inclusion_reason: Specialized loans, 50% capital subsidies, and seed capital schemes for SC beneficiaries.

authorities.inclusion_reason: OBC, VJNT, and SBC PhD fellowships, UPSC/MPSC coaching stipends, and tablet distribution.
ST competitive examination coaching, higher education fellowships, and tribal youth skill development.

authorities.inclusion_reason: Interest refund scheme for youth entrepreneurs (IR-II: up to Rs 15 lakh bank loan interest reimbursement).

authorities.name_en: Vasantrao Naik Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes Development Corporation

authorities.inclusion_reason: Self-employment loans and educational subsidies for VJNT youth.

authorities.name_en: Maulana Azad Minorities Financial Development Corporation (MAMFDC)

authorities.inclusion_reason: Micro-finance, education loans, and term loans for minority community members.

authorities.name_en: Maharashtra State Divyang Finance & Development Corporation
authorities.name_mr: महाराष्ट्र राज्य दिव्यांग वित्त व विकास महामंडळ
authorities.inclusion_reason: Concessional loans and assistive device grants for persons with disabilities.

authorities.name_en: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Research and Training Institute (BARTI)
authorities.name_mr: डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर संशोधन व प्रशिक्षण संस्था (बार्टी)
authorities.inclusion_reason: SC M.Phil/Ph.D. national fellowships (BANRF), UPSC residential coaching, and skill training.

authorities.name_en: Sant Rohidas Leather Industries & Footwear Corporation (LIDCOM)
authorities.name_mr: संत रोहिदास चर्मोद्योग व चर्मकार विकास महामंडळ मर्यादित
authorities.inclusion_reason: Artisan seed capital, footwear kiosk subsidy, and leather worker toolkits.

authorities.name_en: Maharashtra State Other Backward Class Finance & Development Corporation
authorities.name_mr: महाराष्ट्र राज्य इतर मागासवर्गीय वित्त आणि विकास महामंडळ मर्यादित
authorities.inclusion_reason: Term loans and direct financing for traditional occupations of OBC communities.

authorities.name_en: Shabari Adivasi Vitta Va Vikas Mahamandal
authorities.name_mr: शबरी आदिवासी वित्त व विकास महामंडळ मर्यादित
authorities.inclusion_reason: Mini-tractor subsidy, grocery shop loans, and seed money for tribal entrepreneurs.
Legal counseling, rehabilitation assistance, and victim rehabilitation grants.

authorities.name_en: State Health Society, National Health Mission Maharashtra
authorities.inclusion_reason: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY), Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK), and free institutional delivery.

authorities.name_en: Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission (MSRLM Umed)

authorities.name_en: Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Authority (MHADA)
authorities.inclusion_reason: Subsidized housing lottery for EWS, LIG, and MIG categories across Mumbai, Pune, Konkan, Nashik, Amravati, and Nagpur.

authorities.name_en: Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCW)
authorities.name_mr: महाराष्ट्र इमारत व इतर बांधकाम कामगार कल्याणकारी मंडळ

authorities.name_en: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
